caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, symmetrical, and stylized object composed primarily of shades of brown and accented with a metallic, pearl-like sphere at the bottom. The structure is shaped like a pointed arch or a Gothic window and is bordered by a reddish-brown outline. Inside the arch, at the top center, there is a grill-like element with vertical bars, also brown. Below this are intersecting scroll motifs flanking both sides, and in the middle of the arch is a geometric cluster of small spheres, resembling a bunch of grapes, arranged above two crossed cylindrical rods. The rods are positioned as an "X" and are depicted in a lighter, somewhat gold-brown color. The bottom section curves into a looping flourish, with a single round, silver-gray sphere resting within the curve. The object stands alone on a pale, unadorned background.
title: Trivet
